alpha_semantics: RGB is premultiplied by alpha before entering the kernel. Transparent pixels are exactly 0,0,0,0.
canonical_serialization: Hash serialization is row-major R,G,B,A with every uint16 encoded big-endian, exactly 8 bytes per pixel and no header, stride padding, or architecture-dependent bytes. Width, height, surface profile ID, and kernel profile ID are excluded and must be bound by the containing render/evidence manifest.
channel_encoding: Each channel is an unsigned 16-bit integer in [0,65535]; 65535 denotes exact one in the working domain.
dissolve_semantics: For evaluator weights wo,wi in [0,1] with wo+wi=1, evaluate outgoing*wo+incoming*wi per premultiplied linear-light channel, then apply the v1 quantizer once.
excluded_stages: Media decode, YUV/RGB and transfer conversion, chroma upsampling, transform/resampling, masks, text/vector rasterization, output conversion, dithering, encoding and muxing are outside this profile and must be separately versioned.
layer_order: Layer slices are back-to-front: index 0 is the bottom layer and each later layer is source-over composited on top in array order. Host map iteration and parallel completion order never define z-order.
layout: Top-down, row-major, tightly packed pixels; each pixel is R,G,B,A in that order.
light_domain: RGB values are already transfer-decoded linear-light BT.709 values. This kernel never applies a transfer function, matrix, range conversion, chroma reconstruction, ICC transform, or tone map.
opacity_semantics: Multiply premultiplied R,G,B,A by the exact evaluator opacity in [0,1], then apply the v1 quantizer once per channel.
pixel_invariant: For every pixel R<=A, G<=A and B<=A. Invalid input fails before an output is allocated or published.
quantization: Every operation forms its complete exact non-negative rational channel result, then rounds once to the nearest integer; exact half ties choose the even integer. No float, SIMD-dependent approximation, intermediate channel rounding, dithering, or hidden clamp is permitted.
source_over_semantics: Porter-Duff source-over: out.rgb=src.rgb+dst.rgb*(1-src.a), out.a=src.a+dst.a*(1-src.a), with 65535 as exact one and one v1 quantization per output channel.
working_primaries: ITU-R BT.709 / sRGB chromaticities with D65 white point. Inputs with other primaries must be converted or rejected by a separately versioned normalization stage.
